data.title: Neither human nor robot dog: meet the machine set to police our streets - Futura-Sciences
data.description: Founded in Tallinn in 2025 by Sander Sebastian Agur and Arno Kütt, formerly of parcel delivery robotics company Cleveron, Rollo Robotics developed the platform, named 1ROLLO. Specifically, the team set out to address the long-standing engineering challenge of maintaining single-wheel stability during movement, turning, and stopping.
